identity.title: Implement deterministic gap and trend rules

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Implement the mvp-1 heuristic exactly as documented. The LLM is not allowed to decide whether a gap exists.
human_pressure.why_now: This is the product kernel and must be transparent, testable and defensible before any visual polish.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: Do not introduce an opportunity score.
Do not call an LLM to choose the finding.
Do not claim causality or fundability.

machine_core.goal: Implement gap-rules.ts and trend.ts with boundary-focused unit tests and deterministic reason templates.
red_lines: Do not introduce an opportunity score.
Do not call an LLM to choose the finding.
Do not claim causality or fundability.
invariants: Sparse evidence cannot produce a stronger gap classification.
failure_semantics: If required metrics are incomplete, return no valid gap finding and surface the upstream error.

steps.title: Implement trend
details: Return insufficient_data when previous comparison base is too small.

steps.title: Generate reasons
details: Every reason must reference measured/derived values only.

acceptance: All documented rule boundaries have tests.
No LLM is required for gap classification.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
